{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ministry of State''' was a department of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] responsible for foreign policy and relations. Headed by the [[Minister of State]], the Ministry of State served as the internal affairs section of the [[General Ministry]], attending to the bureaucratic needs of the New Republic.

The Ministry of State also possessed a few non-internal duties.
